{{Top|leg}}
'''Submersible harvesters''' were [[Water/Legends|underwater]] vessels designed to harvest [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Submersible harvesters were used by [[Rendeel Industries]] to collect fish from the ocean and transport it to [[Factory/Legends|factories]] and [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]] such as [[Quekka Trench Station]].<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
